translations.ideploy-page.hero.lede: You write the code. iDeploy puts it online, gives it a secure web address, backs it up and watches it. Nothing to install, not a single command to type.
translations.ideploy-page.steps.title: Four steps, once
translations.ideploy-page.steps.body: After that, every change to your code ships on its own.
translations.ideploy-page.where.title: Our servers, or yours
translations.ideploy-page.where.lede: The same product either way. What changes is who owns the machine, and where your data sleeps.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.title: Protected and watched
translations.ideploy-page.guard.lede: Everything switches on from the interface. You never touch the server.
translations.ideploy-page.domain.title: An address people recognise
translations.ideploy-page.domain.lede: Every app gets a working {$START_TAG_STRONG}.idem.africa{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} address the moment it goes live, with its certificate. Point your own domain at it when you are ready — the interface walks you through it, registrar by registrar.
translations.ideploy-page.domain.body: HTTPS is issued and renewed for you. There is no certificate to buy, upload or remember to replace.
translations.ideploy-page.catalogue.title: The software your team already knows, installed in one click
translations.ideploy-page.catalogue.lede: WordPress, Odoo, n8n, Supabase, Nextcloud, Grafana: the open-source tools millions of teams run. iDeploy installs them on our servers or on yours, with an address and backups.
translations.ideploy-page.also.title: And also
translations.ideploy-page.price.title: Your first app is on us
translations.ideploy-page.price.lede: The free plan is enough for a real project in production, commercial use included. You pay the day you need more.
translations.ideploy-page.price.paid: Paid plans start at 2 999 F per month. Mobile Money accepted, no card required.
translations.ideploy-page.around.title: Where the code comes from
translations.ideploy-page.around.body: iDeploy hosts whatever you give it. If you have not written it yet, the rest of IDEM does that part.
translations.ideploy-page.step.connect.title: Connect your code
translations.ideploy-page.step.connect.description: From GitHub, GitLab or a Dockerfile. An app built with iCode arrives without any of that.
translations.ideploy-page.step.where.title: Choose where it runs
translations.ideploy-page.step.where.description: Our servers, or yours. The same product either way, and the choice can change later.
translations.ideploy-page.step.guard.title: Tick what you need
translations.ideploy-page.step.guard.description: Firewall, vulnerability scans, backups. Each one is a switch in the interface, not a config file.
translations.ideploy-page.step.live.title: It is live
translations.ideploy-page.step.live.description: A web address and its certificate, in under a minute. Every push after that deploys on its own.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.title: IDEM infrastructure
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.description: You look after nothing. We pick the machine, maintain it and replace it if it fails.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.care: Updates, security and replacement after a failure: ours.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.data: Hosted on IDEM infrastructure, under your plan.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.idem.fit: You want it to run without thinking about it.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.title: Your own server
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.description: Plug your VPS in once with an SSH key. iDeploy installs it, secures it and keeps it current.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.machine: Your VPS, plugged in once with an SSH key. No server yet? iDeploy rents one for you.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.care: iDeploy installs it, secures it and keeps it current.
translations.ideploy-page.fork.own.fit: You already have a server, or your data has to stay with you.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.firewall.title: Firewall and WAF
translations.ideploy-page.guard.firewall.description: Block an address or a whole country, throttle the request rate, from the interface.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.scans.title: Scans before release
translations.ideploy-page.guard.scans.description: Code quality and known vulnerabilities are checked on every build. If the check fails, nothing ships.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.monitoring.title: Monitoring
translations.ideploy-page.guard.monitoring.descriptio: Requests, CPU, memory and disk, read continuously for your apps and your servers.
translations.ideploy-page.guard.alerts.title: Alerts where you already talk
translations.ideploy-page.guard.alerts.description: When something breaks, the message arrives in the channel your team is already in.
